reason: NSAIDs reduce renal blood flow and can cause acute kidney injury or worsen chronic kidney disease.
Reduced kidney function raises metformin levels and the risk of lactic acidosis.
recommendation: Check eGFR and adjust the dose. Stop if eGFR is below 30.

reason: Non-selective beta blockers can trigger bronchospasm in asthma.
recommendation: Avoid non-selective beta blockers in asthma.
alternative: A different antihypertensive class or a cardioselective agent with caution.

reason: NSAIDs damage the gastric mucosa and can cause ulcer bleeding.
recommendation: Avoid in active or recent peptic ulcer disease.

reason: Aspirin damages the gastric mucosa and can cause ulcer bleeding.
recommendation: Avoid in active peptic ulcer disease unless specifically indicated with gastroprotection.
